name: optim-agent
title_zh: 黑盒调参前先读代码的试错筛选器
tagline_zh: 训练、推理、量化策略、科学计算……每次试错都烧钱。它先读你的项目再挑下一组参数。
tagline_en: Training, inference, quant, RL, science—each trial burns budget. It reads your codebase before picking the next.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to optimize configurable system parameters against a measurable scalar objective, especially for model training, inference, quantitative strategies, reinforcement learning, scientific workflows, or other expensive black-box evaluations where reading the project can improve trial selection.
why_zh: 不盲试。它把代码结构变成先验，让贝叶斯优化从更聪明的起点出发，专治昂贵黑盒目标下试错成本高到不敢动。
why_en: No blind search. It turns your code structure into prior knowledge, so Bayesian optimization starts smarter—built for black-box.
limit_zh: 只认可量化的标量目标，且你的系统参数必须能被它读取和改写。纯交互式调参、无代码接口的闭源软件、或目标不可数值化时。
limit_en: Needs a measurable scalar objective and parameters it can read/write. No help for interactive tuning, closed-source UIs, or non-numeric goals.
title_en: Code-aware trial selector for costly black-box tuning
